text_block_list.name: Trailer Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
Amid the golden age of the steam engine,
there rose a town
wreathed in smog and
steel.

text_block_list.name: Trailer Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
As its denizens grew satiated with the
blessings of this innovative
technology,
they eventually lost the desire to pursue
grand yet
distant dreams.

text_block_list.name: Trailer Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
Job skills will play an important role in
determining how your story
unfolds here.
Additionally, a zero-skill Hard Mode is
available for
players who desire a
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Trailer Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
A VR role-playing experience like no other
awaits you in Steelwing
Chronicle. Soar
beyond the steam and seize your dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Steelwing Chronicle

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Our trailer's live on the official
website! This. Is. So. COOL!
It's just like a
real trailer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh. Well, it's not terrible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, looks like it's got the Taishin seal of
approval. Ticket, can you
play that back
again from the start?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Hey, who said I wanted to see it
again?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! C'mon, let's play already! You
said we could play the game
before it's
released, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I've got an idea! Why don't we play
the game on a VR
Umalator?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's a racing simulator, but you can also
play online games that are
linked to the
network—at least that's what I've heard!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, the director did
say something to that
effect. Hm. The
Umalator would allow players to immerse
their senses
in the game—smell the scents,
feel the breeze, and such. Sounds

interesting.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whooa! That sounds so cool! I wanna try!
Let's go! Look out,
Umalator, here we
come!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
First we pick a job, yeah?! I'm gonna go
with the "Courier," just like I
played in the
trailer! That way, I get the "Operate
Airplane" skill!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Neither rain, sleet, nor abominable snow creature will stand in the way of a swift delivery! Waaaah, this job's just brimming with passion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what about you, Taishin? Are you
gonna go for the "Mechawork
Engineer"?
You really rocked that vibe in the trailer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When we were filming, the crew said you
were just like a real
engineer, the way you
expertly tightened those bolts and
tinkered
with those gadgets!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Except I'm not. I was just trying to fit into
the game world, and being
good with
machines seems like it'd be advantageous!
That's all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Culinartiste, Mechawork Designer,
Steamrunner... Hrm. There are so
many
jobs to choose from. It's hard to narrow
down the choices.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll forgo a job and choose Hard
Mode! Seems like that'd be
the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're goin' Hard Mode?! Then sign me up
too! I'mma mash that Start
button!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?! Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So this is the world of Steelwing Chronicle!
Aaaaah! I can smell the oil
from the
machines and the smoke in the air!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, there's a townsperson! They've got a suitcase, so I guess they're traveling?! And the outfits—whooooa! My outfit changed too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow, wow, woooow! I'm dressed just like a
Courier! Ooh, and look at
you, Taishin! SO
COOOOOL!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Pipe down... You've seen these outfits
loads of times in the trailer,
not to mention
you're already familiar with these job
classes...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, Hayahide? Your outfit...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. I guess I entered the game without
selecting a job. I'm still in
my uniform...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! Hayahide's playing Hard
Mode too? So if you don't pick
a job, you
automatically come in like this?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... I'm sorry! I already decided on a
job, so I hit Start without
thinking!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, Turbo. A little challenge is just
what I'm looking for.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
R-really? Hehe, then let's rock it on Hard
together, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We also have "EX Job Change," which lets us use a one-off job skill! Plus, you've got me by your side. It'll be fine! We'll make it work somehow!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. To beat the game, we have to
clear the missions we're
assigned! There's
nothing listed, though, so maybe we'll get
our
instructions later?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so the information we need is
displayed on this screen... You
really are a
natural at games, Teio. With you on our
team, things
ought to proceed smoothly.

text_block_list.name: NPC
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Collapse!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Did that lady just...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you all right?! Are you hurt
anywhere?!

text_block_list.name: NPC
text_block_list.text: I'm... so... hun... gry...

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: ...What?
